title: Discover, review, own, approve, remediate
lede: Agents in cloud consoles are discovered, their execution identities reviewed and scored, a custodian proposes an action, a tenant administrator approves it, and only then does it run. Every step is written to the audit log with the acting user. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Thirteen sources: AWS, Google, Azure, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake

steps.title: Agents are listed
steps.what: Each provider part of a sync lists its agents and their execution identities.

steps.title: The connector polls out
steps.what: Inside your own network the connector only dials out, through your proxy.

steps.title: Discovery normalises
steps.what: New agents are classified and assigned a custodian from an owner hint, or flagged orphaned.

steps.title: Review
steps.what: Each execution identity is read against what its provider says it can do.

steps.title: Findings reach the custodian
steps.what: The lab's thirteen findings give a five-level score. The deck says 46 findings; those are Ping's.

steps.title: The custodian proposes
steps.what: A custodian can only propose. Nothing runs yet.

steps.title: An administrator approves
steps.what: A different tenant administrator approves or denies; self-approval is refused. Then it executes.

steps.title: It runs at the provider
steps.what: Delete (twelve sources), quarantine (nine) or a targeted fix, simulated.

steps.title: Everything is recorded
steps.what: Each step is written to the audit log with the acting user.
